registration.provisional_note: the RAM (2810.0) and disk (11600.0) onset thresholds are PROVISIONAL (plan §6-§7; the generator marks all three as provisional): the 'no familiar task can cross it' half of the registered argument is measured here on this stream's familiar rows and reported, never assumed

cohort.rule: tasks whose saved per-observation mechanism id is the regime's own; a familiar task and another regime's task are never in this cohort

onsets.followup_rule: the task observes every interval of [t0, t0 + max(registered window))
onsets.usable_followup_rule: at least one interval inside a registered response window is observed, so a response value exists (the P22 U4-v2 MIN_FOLLOWUP_EVENTS definition); reported for comparison, NOT the gated number
onsets.gated_definition: n_valid_followup (full window) -- plan §9 'valid onset/follow-up'; the P22-compatible usable count is reported next to it and the definition is never switched after seeing the number
onsets.cohort_observed_life_note: observed intervals per cohort task; a median well below the followup_horizon is why the full-window count can be far below the usable count

cross_regime_confound.note: onsets an unmapped resource+tau scan attributes to this regime that its own task cohort does not produce; the instrument's tests pin that a regime-A envelope crosses the B/C thresholds, so this number is reported and is NEVER a gate input

durations.definition: intervals inside the registered response windows whose deviation from the pre-onset baseline is > 0, longest of the two response resources

peak_ratio.definition: max over the registered response resources of response_Q / pre-onset baseline_Q

fault_runs.definition: per-host contiguous positive-label runs inside the regime's phase window; a run is attributed to every registered cascade event live and in-window on its host

rejection.note: a rate with zero attempts is reported as null (not measurable) rather than as a fake 0.0, and the count is reported next to it

admissibility.provisional_note: PROVISIONAL threshold: the 'no familiar task can cross it' half of the registered argument is not measured for RAM/disk under P23 (plan §6-§7); the measured maximum above is this stream's own evidence and the threshold is reported, never retuned, when it fails
admissibility.rule: admissible iff the registered threshold is STRICTLY above the measured familiar per-task maximum of its resource; an unmeasurable maximum is reported inadmissible (it cannot be shown to be above the familiar level)
admissibility.measurement_source: per-task maxima over the familiar-phase rows (phase_kind == 0) of this stream

definitions.gate_source: each regime's gate block is measured on its own single-regime stream (the registered clean per-regime cohort); the development stream is reported as context and never enters the gate
definitions.gate: anomaly prevalence 3%-12% / deployment rejection <= 25% / migration rejection <= 40% / independent fault events >= 80 per regime / valid onset-follow-up >= 50 per regime / worst event share < 10% / regime prevalence difference <= 4 percentage points
definitions.marginal_matching: core23.marginal_match_report over the eight registered numbers; core23.regime_contrast_report is reported next to it as context -- its tolerances are instrument-local and are not the registered gate
definitions.recomputation: every gate quantity is recomputed from stream.npz + task_timeline.npz with ftmoe_protocol023_core; the collector's unseen_data_audit.json is only ever compared against the recomputation
definitions.cohort: onsets are scanned with task_regime_map, so a regime-A envelope whose RAM/Disk responses cross the B/C thresholds is never counted as a B/C event; the unmapped scan is reported as the cross-hit confound count
definitions.independent_fault_events: per-host contiguous positive-label runs inside the regime's phase window (the registered P22 segmentation rule, reimplemented here)
definitions.valid_onset_followup: onsets whose task observes every interval of [t0, t0 + max registered response window)) -- the plan §9 'valid onset/follow-up' the ≥50 threshold is applied to; the P22-compatible 'usable follow-up' count (at least one observed interval inside a window) is reported next to it and is NOT gated
definitions.worst_event_share: positive host-steps attributed to the single worst registered cascade event, over the window's positives (the collector's definition); the label-free worst-run share is reported next to it
definitions.mean_duration: core23.response_durations over the regime's onset cohort: intervals inside the registered response windows whose deviation from the pre-onset baseline is > 0, longest of the two response resources
definitions.peak_ratio: core23.peak_ratio_summary over the same cohort; the registered matched marginal uses the MEDIAN peak ratio (robust to one large excursion) and the mean is reported next to it
definitions.admissibility: a registered onset threshold is admissible only if it is strictly above the measured familiar per-task maximum of its resource; a failure is reported with its negative margin and never retuned
